title: bidens selenactis
intro: Bidens selenactis, commonly known as Tickseed, is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and act as an antiseptic agent. The health benefits of Bidens selenactis include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Tickseed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
